# kion_compliance_level (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion ComplianceLevel by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_compliance_level" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the ComplianceLevel to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `compliance_program_id` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
